eval: (() => { const ks = []; for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) { const k = localStorage.key(i); if (k && k.startsWith('dao-')) ks.push(k); } ks.forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k)); location.reload(); return 'cleared'; })()

(() => { window.__dao.setStage(12); document.getElementById('btn-talents').click(); const click = id => document.querySelector(`.tnode[data-id="${id}"]`).dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); ['b1','b2'].forEach(click); document.getElementById('talent-close').click(); return JSON.stringify(window.__dao.slots()); })()

(() => { const p = window.__dao; p.clear(); p.place('daotong'); const hp0 = p.state.playerQueue[0].maxHp; const r = [p.place('xuantie-jian','held'), p.place('xiaohulu','held')]; const q = p.state.playerQueue; const char = q.find(u=>u.cardType==='char'); const sword = q.find(u=>u.cardId==='xuantie-jian'); const hulu = q.find(u=>u.cardId==='xiaohulu'); const expect = hp0 + Math.round((sword.maxHp + hulu.maxHp) * 0.30); return JSON.stringify({ r, hp0, swordHp: sword.maxHp, huluHp: hulu.maxHp, charHp: char.maxHp, expect, mergeOk: char.maxHp === expect, modes: q.map(u=>u.mode), swordCd: sword.cd }); })()

(() => { const p = window.__dao; const before = p.state.playerQueue.find(u=>u.cardId==='xuantie-jian').cd; const charBefore = p.state.playerQueue.find(u=>u.cardType==='char').cd; document.getElementById('btn-talents').click(); const click = id => document.querySelector(`.tnode[data-id="${id}"]`).dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); ['b3','b4','b10'].forEach(click); document.getElementById('talent-close').click(); const sword = p.state.playerQueue.find(u=>u.cardId==='xuantie-jian'); const char = p.state.playerQueue.find(u=>u.cardType==='char'); return JSON.stringify({ swordCdBefore: before, swordCdAfter: sword.cd, swordOk: sword.cd === Math.round(before/1.06), charCdBefore: charBefore, charCdAfter: char.cd, charOk: char.cd === Math.round(charBefore/1.06) }); })()
(() => { const p = window.__dao; p.setStage(0); p.state.enemyQueue.splice(3); p.start(); return JSON.stringify({ enemies: p.state.enemyQueue.length, running: p.state.running }); })()

(() => { const s = window.__dao.state; const char = s.playerQueue.find(u=>u.cardType==='char'); const sword = s.playerQueue.find(u=>u.cardId==='xuantie-jian'); const hulu = s.playerQueue.find(u=>u.cardId==='xiaohulu'); const foes = s.enemyQueue.filter(u=>u.status==='alive'); return JSON.stringify({ charHurt: char.hp < char.maxHp, charAlive: char.status==='alive', swordUntouched: sword.hp === sword.maxHp, huluUntouched: hulu.hp === hulu.maxHp, huluHealDone: hulu.healDone, huluAttacked: hulu.damageDealt > 0, swordSwung: sword.lastTargetUid !== null, enemyFocusChar: foes.every(u=>u.lastTargetUid===null||u.lastTargetUid===char.uid) }); })()

(async () => { const s = window.__dao.state; const sword = s.playerQueue.find(u=>u.cardId==='xuantie-jian'); const t0 = Date.now(); while (Date.now() - t0 < 8000) { if ((sword.damageDealt||0) > 0) return JSON.stringify({ swordAttacked: true, swordDamage: Math.round(sword.damageDealt) }); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80)); } return JSON.stringify({ swordAttacked: false, swordSwung: sword.lastTargetUid !== null, swordStatus: sword.status }); })()
